newsitem.title: INDIA: India Nov-Jan soymeal export deals at 460,000T.
newsitem.headline: India Nov-Jan soymeal export deals at 460,000T.

text.p: Indian exporters have signed forward contracts to export 460,000 tonnes of soymeal during November, December and January, traders said on Tuesday.
Traders said the biggest buyer was Singapore's Peter Cremer which had contracted for 130,000 tonnes. Another Singapore firm G. Premjee contracted for 40,000 tonnes.
Cargill Hong Kong had signed deals for 50,000 tonnes and another Hong Kong-based company Concordia had contracted for 60,000 tonnes, traders said.
Details of the remaining 90,000 tonnes of soymeal contracts were not available, traders said.
India's OILFED, MMTC, State Trading Corporation, Gujarat Ambuja Protein Ltd, Prestige Foods Ltd and Ruchi Soya Industries were the main sellers.
Soymeal export prices for November-January shipments had fallen to $280 per tonne F.A.S, which was around $285 per tonne last week on reports of a good soybean harvest in central India.
"There is a downward trend noted in the soymeal export prices this week on reports of better yields," said an oilmeal trader.
New soybean, of around 100 tonnes per day, had started arriving in the markets of central India, the hub of India's soymeal industry.
The central state of Madhya Pradesh accounts for 80 percent of the country's total soybean output.
